prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent Asinu mascot sticker for a mobile Care Circle header.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the same recognizable glossy turquoise Asinu character, rounded body, large friendly eyes, smiling mouth, short legs, olive Vietnamese pith helmet with red circular badge and yellow star, polished 3D cartoon finish and colors.
Change only the pose, orientation and gaze: body and helmet squarely face the viewer, perfectly front-on. Both eyes and pupils look directly straight at the viewer, centered, with no sideways glance. BOTH arms extend sideways in opposite directions at the same height: viewer-left index finger points horizontally LEFT; viewer-right index finger points horizontally RIGHT. Exactly two arms and two hands, clear natural pointing fingers. The hands indicate two separate controls placed on opposite sides in the app. Keep friendly smile.
Composition: one full-body character centered on square canvas, symmetrical balanced silhouette, same distance from each fingertip to its canvas edge. Keep all fingertips, helmet and feet in frame with small transparent margins. Both pointing fingertips at the same vertical level, near the vertical midpoint of the canvas. Readable at 128px display.
Genuinely transparent alpha background. No text, speech bubble, buttons, QR code, extra objects, backdrop, floor, watermark or shadow plate. The app supplies those separately.
